titles.refresh_control:
ioquake3 1.36: r_displayRefresh is DEAD.
- It is registered at 0x4d6bc7-0x4d6c09: Cvar_Get(name@0x52cbb6, flags 0x20 CVAR_LATCH) stored in global 0x1d9f7c0, then Cvar_CheckRange 0..200 (0x43480000).
- The only code reference to 0x1d9f7c0 is that store (0x4d6c04), and the name string has one reference. Nothing ever reads the value.

The rate comes from SDL 1.2.13:
- SDL_desktop_mode = EnumDisplaySettings(NULL, ENUM_CURRENT_SETTINGS) at video init (0x68137884), i.e. the LIVE mode.
- The DX5 fullscreen GL path (0x681388be), and identically the DIB path (0x68134d40), sets dmDisplayFrequency = SDL_desktop_mode's rate with dmFields 0x5c0000 only when w<=desktop_w and h<=desktop_h. Otherwise it uses 0x1c0000 (no rate).
- If CDS_FULLSCREEN fails, it clears 0x400000 and retries (0x68138935).
- There is no environment variable or cvar lever: ioquake3 always gets the live desktop rate, or the driver default.

Retail 1.32c honours r_displayRefresh.
- GLW_SetMode reads global 0xc59ba0 (+0x20) at 0x459ee7. dmFields goes from 0x180000 to 0x580000 and dmDisplayFrequency is set when the value is non-zero, then CDS_FULLSCREEN.
- If the CDS fails it prints '...trying next higher resolution:' and loops EnumDisplaySettings for the first mode with w>=, h>= and bpp>=15, applied at THAT entry's own rate (0x45a01a-0x45a07c).
- ENUM_CURRENT read-back at 0x45a1a8 becomes 'MODE: ... hz:N'.

.124 adds a layer on top:
- MesaFX fxBestRefresh asks Glide for the best listed rate. C:\retrogl.log shows ioquake3 12x '1280x960 max 85 Hz -> GR_REFRESH enum 7'.
- Our h5 Glide hwcInitVideo (minihwc.c:4675) replaces that with FX_GLIDE_REFRESH. hwcGetenv reads process getenv, then HKCU, then HKLM ...\Services\3dfxvs\Device0\glide.
- REGREAD 04:10: HKLM FX_GLIDE_REFRESH is REG_SZ '75'. No HKCU key, no environment variable, GlideRender=1.
- Glide then calls IDirectDraw2_SetDisplayMode(w,h,bpp,refresh) and retries at 0 on failure (win_mode.c:326-331).

- Latent: ioquake3 can only inherit the live desktop rate. If the game mode's best is above the desktop mode's rate (a CRT), or the mode is larger than a stranded live desktop, it gets the desktop rate or the driver default. On XP + ForceWare the default is measured at 60 (agent/tools/refreshlogic.h).
titles.fix:
- LCD boxes: no change needed.
- .124: in all three Q3 launchers, before 'start', set 'if "%FR_UE1DEV%"=="GlideDrv.GlideRenderDevice" set "FX_GLIDE_REFRESH=<rate>"'. The staged FLEETRES.EXE (bb180f3b...) already publishes FR_UE1DEV=GlideDrv only when HKLM\Software\RetroAgent\GlideRender=1 and 3dfx silicon is present, which today means .124 only.
  - Rate: interim %FR_HZ% (85 today); %FR_HZW% once the mechanism lane's gr_target_hz tokens land. Skip the line when the value is 0 or unreal.
  - A process environment variable beats the HKLM '75' (getenv comes first).
  - It fixes both ioquake3->retroicd and retail->3dfxOGL.
  - It leaves the V5 lane's V56KBENCH.BAT/LANCHECK.BAT (no FX_GLIDE_REFRESH) at 75.
  - Generate it from stage-fleetres.py, like glide_swap(); do not edit the share only. FLEETGL.BAT is share-only today.
- Do NOT use 3dfxctl 'Auto' or edit HKLM/HKCU. That is a 3dfx driver-setting change on the V5 lane's box, needs an explicit chat decision, and drops 3dfxOGL and Glide-native paths that ask for 60 down to 60.
- Retail line: when the per-target tokens land, change %FR_HZ% to %FR_HZW% in all three launchers AND %FRHZ% to %HZW% in gr_cfg_body(NULL) in the SAME release. The number is the same today on every box.
- ioquake3: no per-title lever exists. Keep GAMERES' desktop raise; refreshkeep only on non-Glide boxes.
titles.fix_risk:
- .124 belongs to the V5 benchmark lane. Its desktop-shortcut runs (scripts/benchmarks/lan_check.py, the 'Quake III ioquake3 1280x960x32' row) were taken at 75 and would move to 85; direct-exe bench scripts would not.
- CRT pacing: one launch at a time, 5 s or more apart.
- 85 must be listed at every Glide open. GAMERES lists it at 1280x960 and at 320x200, which covers SDL's 10x10 probe open (retrogl.log shows 'res=0 (320x200)'). Otherwise Glide silently retries at refresh 0.
- The interim %FR_HZ% follows the persisted desktop rate. If .124's desktop were ever left at 60, it would pin Glide at 60, worse than today's 75. %FR_HZW% removes that risk.
- Latent, pre-existing: FLEETRES FR_HZ (fleetres.c:882, persisted 50..240, else live, else 60) differs from gameres.h fr_hz (persisted 50..199, else 60). Not triggered on any connected box.
- Any launcher change needs a restage, validate-staged-library, a purge + GAMESYNC on one box, then a push to all boxes.

titles.refresh_control:
The cvar is a static idCVar r_displayRefresh at 0x7d3a1c: default "0", flags 0x5012 = INTEGER|RENDERER|STATIC|NOCHEAT (NO CVAR_ARCHIVE), range 0..200.

Use:
- R_InitOpenGL (0x4acd59) copies it into glimpParms.displayHz for GLimp_Init (0x50c260). The vid_restart path does the same at 0x4ad82b.
- The safe-mode fallback sets it to 0 (0x4acdc5).

GLW_SetFullScreen (0x50b910):
- First it scans EnumDisplaySettings for a 32-bpp mode with w>= and h>= (and freq == displayHz if non-zero).
- If a mode is big enough but none carries the rate, it logs '...%dhz is unsupported at %dx%d' and zeroes the rate.
- If no 32-bpp mode is big enough, it logs '...%dx%d is unsupported in 32 bit' and fails.
- Then dmFields 0x1c0000, plus DM_DISPLAYFREQUENCY (0x5c0000) only when the rate is non-zero, and CDS_FULLSCREEN.
- On failure: '...trying next higher resolution:'.

glConfig.displayFrequency (0x138b42c) is never written, only read by GfxInfo, so the log always says 'hz:N/A'.

The lever is '+set r_displayRefresh N' on the command line.

titles.fix_risk:
Low. The rate must be listed at the EXACT 32-bpp mode:
- If no mode at least that big carries it, the engine zeroes the rate. Harmless.
- If only a larger mode carries it, the CDS fails. The engine then takes the next-higher fallback (another mode and/or rate), and if that also fails it drops to safe mode at 640x480 with the rate reset to 0.
gr_best_hz at FR_W x FR_H avoids all of this.
